capabilities: Consolidate ingredients from selected recipe notes into a category-grouped grocery list
Render recipe notes in a dedicated view with scaled quantities, badges, and checkable steps
Plan weekly meals in a grid backed by a plain-Markdown note and push the plan to the grocery list
Track on-hand inventory quantities and omit in-stock items from the list
Import recipes from URLs or pasted text into normalized notes
disambiguation: Not just a food-inventory tracker; its core job is consolidating recipe notes into a grocery list, with inventory as one supporting feature.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The author maintains a companion recipe-library vault at github.com/Ekrizdis367/Cooking that works with the plugin out of the box.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage recipes as structured notes, aggregate their ingredients into a shopping list, or plan meals from linked notes.
summary: Recipe manager that turns flagged recipe notes into a consolidated, category-grouped grocery list and renders recipes as an interactive cooking view.
